name: Aved Electronics
old_description: When lives depend on technology, there’s no room for failure.
about:
Aved Electronics operates from Lowell, Massachusetts, as a brand under Lithion Battery Inc. The company focuses on custom power solutions for applications where reliability is critical.

Aved designs and manufactures custom battery packs, cable and harness assemblies, and electro-mechanical box builds. Its services span battery pack design and manufacturing, cable assembly, electro-mechanical integration, testing, and compliance support. The company states it is one of the largest custom battery pack manufacturers in the United States, with all production taking place at its Massachusetts facility.

The company serves customers ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 firms across medical, military and defense, robotics, security, telecommunications, semiconductor, oceanographic research, homeland security, and industrial sectors. Its products are used in medical diagnosis, therapy, treatment, and surgery equipment, as well as in robotics and military operations.

Aved emphasizes a chemistry-agnostic approach, working with lithium-ion, primary lithium, nickel-metal hydride, and lead-acid cells. It maintains a quality management system certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 13485, and performs 100 percent testing on every battery produced. The company positions itself as a full-service custom battery solution designer, manufacturer, assembler, and tester, taking projects from prototype through production.
